replacements.old: entry_text: "The broadcast chamber lights steadied as Brandon's relay held open. Outside, Charles's emergency deluge was filling the outer access level and forcing water toward the maintenance routes; inside, the evidence was ready to leave for good.\n\n"
replacements.new: entry_text: "The broadcast chamber lights are steady. Brandon's relay is open. Michelle's evidence package is ready to send. Water is entering the outer access level.\n\n"

replacements.old: delivery_text: "Kristin stops Rebecca from fleeing with the data case. Michelle sends its prisoner locations to independent networks. Water rises around the drainage pump controls."
replacements.new: delivery_text: "Kristin takes the Portable data case from Rebecca. Michelle sends its prisoner locations to independent networks. The drainage pumps need power. Water rises around the drainage pump controls."
